vulnerability.name: USN-5405-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that jbig2dec incorrectly handled memory when parsing invalid files. An attacker could use this issue to cause jbig2dec to crash, leading to a denial of service. (CVE-2017-9216)  It was discovered that jbig2dec incorrectly handled memory when processing untrusted input. An attacker could use this issue to cause a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2020-12268)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in jbig2dec. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
